name: cr603_4_sand_scout_fetches_a_desert_tapped_when_behind_on_lands
why: CR 603.4, 701.23: Sand Scout's ETB is an intervening-if comparing an opponent's lands with yours (CheckSVar$ Y | SVarCompare$ GTX, Y = PlayerCountOpponents$HighestValid Land.YouCtrl, each player its own "you"): B's three lands beat A's two, so A searches for a Desert, Lazotep Quarry, which enters tapped.
